<!-- SahkaarX Team Pull Request Template -->

## 📝 Description
Provide a concise explanation of the change, motivation, and problem it solves.

Closes # (issue number if applicable)

---

## 🔀 Type of Change
Select all that apply:
- [ ] `feat`: New feature or capability
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates or additions
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring without behavioral alteration
- [ ] `test`: Unit or integration test addition/update
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling, build pipeline, or dependency bump

---

## 🧪 Testing Performed
Describe testing steps and verification evidence:
- [ ] Unit tests added / updated and passing (`pytest -v`)
- [ ] Static typing verified (`mypy --strict`)
- [ ] Code formatting and linting verified (`black --check .`, `ruff check .`)
- [ ] Manual smoke tests / verification commands run (list below):
  ```bash
  # paste test commands run here
  ```

---

## 📋 Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the project's style guidelines.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation (e.g., `README.md`).
- [ ] My changes introduce no new linting warnings or type-check errors.
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published in downstream modules.
